The Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection API responses, recorded once on 2026-10-19 with the
Pinakes user agent (`pinakes/0.1.0 (+https://pubky.app; info@synonym.to)`), at least one second
apart (the API allows 80 requests per second). Parser regression fixtures for
`pinakes_core::sources::met`; test runs make no requests.

`provenance.json` lists each fixture's request URL, status, content type, recording time, and the
size and SHA-256 of the body as served. The data is CC0 (The Met's Open Access policy); images of
public-domain works (`isPublicDomain`) are CC0 as well.
